content: Refund policy: unopened hardware can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Opened items may qualify for exchange or store credit when defective or materially not as described.
Password reset steps: verify the customer email address, issue a reset link, and confirm whether multi-factor authentication is blocking sign-in before escalating the case.
Shipping delay guidance: confirm the carrier scan history, current warehouse status, and whether the order includes back-ordered items before promising a delivery date.
